summary: Example task runs show version on ENOS with community.network.enos_command.
questions: How do I get the ENOS version with Ansible?

answer_card.title: Get ENOS version
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
- name: Retrieve ENOS OS version
  community.network.enos_command:
    commands: show version
  when: ansible_network_os == 'community.network.enos'
```
